name: Tachibana Kaoru
source:
The protagonist of this story. A second-year student at Aoba First Municipal High School.
She has an elusive personality, but at heart she is honest and straightforward.
She often says random things that leave those around her exasperated, but she's also a bit of a scatterbrain, and it's frequently hard to tell if she's serious or joking.

She has a superficial interest in everything, and her hobbies are wide-ranging and shallow, including fashion, cosmetics, stuffed animals, and smartphone games.

Kaoru's feelings for [url=/c107508]Shimotsuki Mirei[/url], her first love, are special. Therefore, although she is often confessed to by both boys and girls at school, she has never accepted a confession and doesn't even consider them.
Mirei was Kaoru's homeroom teacher in middle school. Kaoru fell in love with Mirei after a runaway incident that occurred when she was in her third year of middle school.
Although they initially cut off contact, after reuniting in high school, she and Mirei have continued their unnamed relationship, occasionally going on dates together.

[From [url=https://lycoris-works.com/usonatsu#character]official website[/url]]
